scope: Local source, GUI, installer and Portable acceptance; not cloud-account approval or external publication

packaged.name: Candidate installer and Portable exist, have PE signatures and are version-addressed
Portable fresh run uses bundled runtime, no inherited config/key/Skills or auto-start
Real GUI creates, renames and switches private accounts; invalid cross-account configuration is rejected
Two real bundled MCP processes run concurrently; switching and stopping B preserve A
Packaged Skills are account-scoped; nested same-name files and real load_skill/node shim work without global Node
Actual packaged narrow window keeps controls visible, has no overflow or renderer exceptions
Portable restart preserves both configurations without auto-start; Skill uninstall is scoped
Real NSIS installer registers only isolated candidate; installed app starts bundled MCP and keeps account data
Silent uninstall removes only installed candidate and preserves data; original installation and live service unchanged

dependencies.auditScope: npm audit against the pinned desktop dependency graph at validation time; not a guarantee against unknown vulnerabilities

limitations: Unsigned Windows installer and Portable; publisher reputation and code-signing certification were not established.
Two local bundled MCP instances were verified. Two real ChatGPT cloud-account tunnel connections were not tested.
Account separation is configuration/process separation under one Windows user, not an OS security sandbox.
No automatic migration of another product's credentials and no replacement of the existing installation.
No GitHub push, tag or Release was performed.
Lock-based source builds were verified; independently rebuilt installer bytes may differ because of build metadata and timestamps.
